name: crudui-generator-svelte-tools
description: The tools of packages/generator-svelte that need the TypeScript 6 API (svelte-check, @sveltejs/package and the Svelte lint of ESLint with typescript-eslint): a project of its own, outside the npm workspaces of the repository, so that no package that npm hoists to the root loads the TypeScript 7 of the root (config/toolchain.json exceptions).
